comingSoon.title: Not built yet: arrives in phase {{phase}}
comingSoon.now: Locarr is being built in phases. Accounts, security, settings, media folders, background tasks, download clients and the download queue work today.

sections.movies: Search TMDb, add and monitor movies, grab releases and import them into your library with hardlinks.
sections.series: Follow series, seasons and episodes, including season packs, anime numbering and daily shows.
sections.music: Follow artists and albums from MusicBrainz and import releases with their tags and covers.
sections.requests: Users ask for movies, series and albums; administrators approve them or let them through automatically.
sections.calendar: Upcoming episodes and releases, on the web and as an iCal feed.
sections.wanted: Missing titles and titles below their quality cutoff, with one-click searches.
sections.indexers: Torznab and Newznab indexers, or Prowlarr and Jackett as a source, with health and backoff.

requestMovies.hint: Ask for movies to be added.

testErrors.unreachable: Cannot connect: check the host, port and that the client is running.

downloaders.title: Download clients
downloaders.subtitle: Torrent and usenet clients Locarr sends releases to, and how it finds their files.
downloaders.none: No download clients yet. Add qBittorrent, SABnzbd or another client to start downloading.

pick.title: Which client?
pick.subtitle: The form only asks for what that client needs.

form.name: Name
form.priorityHint: 1 is tried first; clients with the same priority take turns.
form.categoriesHint: Locarr puts its downloads in these categories and only looks at them. Missing ones are created on the first download.
form.directoryCategories: This client has no categories: each one is a sub-folder of its download folder.
form.noCategories: This client has no categories. Locarr tells its own downloads apart by their ID.
form.removeCompletedHint: Only after the seeding goals (ratio or time) are met; the imported files stay in the library.
form.tagsHint: Comma-separated. A client with tags is only used for releases with one of them.

fields.hostHint: Name or IP address only, without http://.
fields.urlBaseHint: Only when the client is behind a reverse proxy path.
fields.directory: Download folder (as the client sees it)
fields.directoryHint: Leave empty to use the client's own setting.
fields.allowSelfSignedHint: Turns certificate checks off for this client only. Use it only on your own network.

test.missingCategories: Connected, but these categories are missing: {{categories}}.
test.createdOnGrab: Locarr creates them on the first download, or create them now.
test.createByHand: Create them in the client itself (for Deluge, turn on the Label plugin).

mappings.title: Remote path mappings
mappings.subtitle: When a client runs on another machine or container and sees the files under another path.
mappings.none: No mappings. With the single /data mount (see the setup guide) none are needed.

tracking.title: Download tracking
tracking.subtitle: How Locarr follows downloads in the clients.
tracking.hint: While the queue is open, clients are checked every few seconds. 0 hours = never fail stalled torrents.

activity.forbidden: Only library managers can see the download queue.

queue.noClients: No download clients yet. Add one under Downloaders.

blocklist.title: Blocked releases
blocklist.subtitle: Locarr never grabs these releases again.
